payload.proof_nl: Let x be an arbitrary real number. By definition, floor(x) is the greatest integer less than or equal to x. In particular, floor(x) itself is an integer that does not exceed x, so floor(x) ≤ x. Since x was arbitrary, this holds for every real number x.
payload.role_in_assembly: Provides the basic lower floor bound used upstream to prove nonnegativity of x - floor(x).
